title: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in 2.10 Legacy Theming in Apache JSPWIKI version 2.10.0 through 3.0.0 on all platforms…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the 2.10 Legacy Theming feature of Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.10.0 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. This flaw allows specially crafted filenames of uploaded attachments to potentially render unescaped HTML or JavaScript in users' browsers. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.1.
